bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 14 × 14 × 6 inches are permitted and searched. Backpacks, including drawstring and fanny packs, are prohibited; medical and parenting bags are exceptions.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The arena has a PARC-operated multilevel garage beneath it and says more than 21,000 spaces are within five blocks. Advance reservations are available through its preferred parking partners.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a specific rideshare pickup or drop-off location in its A-Z guide.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The arena has more than 170 fixed and portable concessions points. Concessions are cashless and accept major cards and mobile payments.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: An accessible drop-off area is on Main Street between Second and Third Streets, with ramp access at Pepsi Plaza. The arena offers accessible seating and sensory bags at the Fan Assistance booth on the main concourse.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets may be collected at any open ticket-office window starting 60 minutes before the event; bring a valid picture ID. Certain VIP and promoter pickups may have different times.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors typically open 60 to 90 minutes before the event; the precise time varies by artist or promoter. Guests undergo security screening at entry.
